    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        double P = sc.nextDouble();

            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            double x = cal(mid, N);
            if (x >= P) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(low);
    }

    private static double cal(int m, int n) {
        long total = comb(n, 3);
        double ans = 0.0;
        ans += (double) comb(m, 3);
        ans += (double) comb(m, 2) * comb(n - m, 1);
        ans += 0.5 * comb(m, 1) * comb(n - m, 2);
        return ans / total;
    }

    private static long comb(int n, int c) {
        if (c > n) return 0;
        if (c == n) return 1;
        long ans = 1L;
        for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
            ans *= (n - i);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
            ans /= i;
        }
        return ans;
    }

import java.util.Scanner;

public final class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int totalVertices = scanner.nextInt();
        double targetProbability = scanner.nextDouble();
        int left = 0;
        int right = totalVertices - 1;
        while (true) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (left == right) {
                System.out.println(left);
                return;
            }
            double prob = computeProbability(mid, totalVertices);
            if (prob >= targetProbability) {
                right = mid;
            } else {
                left = mid + 1;
            }
        }
    }

    private static double computeProbability(int m, int n) {
        long totalWays = combination(n, 3);
        double numerator = 0.0;
        numerator += combination(m, 3);
        numerator += (double) combination(m, 2) * combination(n - m, 1);
        numerator += 0.5 * combination(m, 1) * combination(n - m, 2);
        return numerator / totalWays;
    }

    private static long combination(int n, int k) {
        if (k > n) return 0;
        if (k == n) return 1;
        long result = 1L;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            result *= (n - i);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            result /= i;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
